product.description: Adventure awaits and we have the perfect wagon for it! Our heavy duty, all-terrain wagon is designed to haul just about any load of outdoor essentials with a maximum weight capacity of up to 175 lbs. It features a 600D oxford fabric construction that is both mildew and UV resistant, and can be easily removed for cleaning. The large 10" diameter, extra wide wheels are perfect for difficult terrain, such as thick grass and sandy beaches. The adjustable handle, 175 lbs. weight capacity, and large 32.8" x 18.0" x 10.3" internal dimensions make this wagon perfect for all outdoor activities. Use it on grass, sand, mud, snow, or even on slippery, rain soaked concrete.
